name: TinyPM Orchestrator
description: Intelligent project management agent with predictive capabilities, multi-agent coordination, proactive intelligence, and behavioral pattern analysis. Part of the Tiny Seed Farm OS ecosystem.

skills.name: Task Management
skills.description: Create, update, track, and complete project tasks. Supports prioritization, assignment, dependencies, and status tracking. Can delegate development tasks to the Builder agent.
examples: Create a new task for implementing user authentication
What tasks are currently in progress?
Mark task #123 as complete
Assign the API refactor task to Builder
Show me overdue tasks
What's blocking our launch?

skills.name: Predictive Intelligence
skills.description: Predict user needs based on behavioral patterns, time-of-day context, calendar state, and work history. Uses Markov chains, LRU pattern caching, and context fusion to generate proactive suggestions before the user asks. SOTA 2026 implementation with pattern mining, sequence prediction, and confidence scoring.
examples: What should I focus on next?
Analyze my work patterns
When is the best time for deep work?
What tasks typically follow my current activity?
Predict what I need before I ask

skills.name: Agent Delegation
skills.description: Delegate development tasks to the Builder agent for code generation, bug fixes, and feature implementation. Coordinates multi-agent workflows with task queuing, status tracking, and completion monitoring.
examples: Build a new API endpoint for user management
Fix the authentication bug in the login flow
Implement the new dashboard feature
Refactor the database queries for performance
What is Builder working on?

skills.name: Status Reporting
skills.description: Get comprehensive status reports on projects, tasks, builder progress, and system health. Includes launch readiness tracking, alert consolidation, and calendar/email context integration.
examples: Give me a project status update
How is the Builder progressing?
Show me the system health report
What's our launch readiness percentage?
How many tasks are in each status?

skills.name: Wizard Council Decision
skills.description: Multi-agent collaborative decision making for complex architectural choices and strategic decisions. Gathers perspectives from multiple expert agents to reach consensus on difficult problems.
examples: Should we use PostgreSQL or MongoDB for this project?
Evaluate the architecture options for our new service
What's the best approach for scaling our API?
Analyze the tradeoffs between microservices and monolith

skills.name: Wild Claims Verification
skills.description: Research and verify claims about technologies, products, or statements. Uses the Wild Claims Czar agent to fact-check and provide sourced evidence for or against claims.
examples: Is it true that Python is faster than JavaScript for web servers?
Verify this claim about React Native performance
Research whether this vendor's promises are realistic
Fact-check this technology comparison
